mutation: the frozen Run-15 threshold is applied under ANY feature schema, so a laboratory threshold fitted on one representation of a project flags projects under another
guard: no exploratory flag is derived from the frozen synthetic threshold under a schema that is not the one it was fitted on

mutation: the minimum cohort for a cross-project anomaly model is lowered back to v21's two, so a two-project cohort is scored although each project is the other's entire reference population
guard: a cohort of two eligible projects is NOT_ESTIMABLE and produces no score

mutation: a small cohort is declared to permit an authoritative anomaly flag, although no calibration protocol establishes one at that cohort size
guard: a cohort below the canonical size does not permit an authoritative flag, and its limitation record says so

target: the protocol ordering (tree-count selection vs holdout inspection)
mutation: the recorded ordering is inverted: the artefact now says the tree count was selected AFTER the holdout was inspected, which is exactly the post-hoc selection the protocol prohibits
guard: the campaign records that selection completed BEFORE the holdout was read, and the selected tree count is the published default rather than a value fitted to the holdout

mutation: the feature-schema check is disabled, so members written under two different schemas -- and therefore scored by two different models -- enter one cohort and are ranked as one scale
guard: a member on a different feature schema is refused, so scores from different cohort/model identities are never compared as one scale

mutation: an orientation that is not one of the declared vocabulary is silently coerced to higher-is-worse, so a feature nobody validly oriented is ranked anyway -- and a lower-is-worse feature would read exactly backwards
guard: a feature whose declared orientation is not in the governed vocabulary is refused; no orientation is defaulted or inferred

mutation: equal weights appear as a DEFAULT when no governed weight set was supplied, so a composite nobody authorised the weighting of is emitted anyway
guard: absent governed weights, PH.2 emits NO composite and returns the per-feature percentile profile under PARAMETER_PROVENANCE_BLOCKED

mutation: the removed percentile-to-status colour mapping is restored, with no governed calibration dataset and no predeclared decision objective behind it
guard: PH.2 declares no status bands and emits no status colour

mutation: two observations are accepted as a trajectory, although two points determine a line exactly and carry no evidence that the line is a trend
guard: a history of two observations is refused: at least three are required before a trend is fitted

mutation: unequally spaced reporting dates are treated as equally spaced: the slope is fitted against the position index instead of the actual reporting time
guard: an unequally spaced history is fitted against its ACTUAL reporting times, so its slope per day differs from the slope over positions 0, 1, 2

mutation: the floating-point zero tolerance is inflated into an operational magnitude band: a real adverse slope of 0.01 per day would now be reported STABLE
guard: the tolerance is numerical only -- a genuine non-zero slope is classified by its sign and no magnitude of slope is graded

mutation: the retired unvalidated 0.15 radius reappears as an operational threshold
guard: PH.4 applies NO match threshold and reports the continuous relationship only

mutation: a member on a different feature schema, and therefore a different normalization version, is accepted into the cohort and compared by distance
guard: a schema mismatch is refused, so no distance is computed across incompatible feature representations

mutation: the declared tie rule and the stable member ordering are both dropped, so the nearest neighbour a project is given depends on the order its record happened to arrive in
guard: every nearest-neighbour set and distance is identical whichever order the records arrive in

mutation: equal constituent weights appear with no governed weight record behind them
guard: PH.5 reports no weights and does not claim governed weights were supplied when none were

mutation: a missingness policy is asserted that would renormalise the composite over whichever constituents happen to be present, silently reweighting the remainder
guard: no governed missingness policy exists, and PH.5 says so rather than adopting one

mutation: the evidence-body count is replaced by a count of CONSTITUENTS and corroboration is derived from it, so the same result offered twice reads as two supporting observations
guard: offering the same constituent twice does not raise the evidence-body count and does not establish corroboration

mutation: a numeric composite is emitted while the disposition still says the parameter provenance is blocked
guard: PH.5 emits no scalar while its disposition is PARAMETER_PROVENANCE_BLOCKED

mutation: the calibration fixture relabels itself as empirical field validation, which would make a generated separation statistic read as evidence about real projects
guard: every calibration fixture declares data_origin SYNTHETIC_RESEARCH_CALIBRATION, not_for_empirical_validation true, and ground truth defined before the detector

mutation: the holdout generator seed is set equal to the calibration seed, so the 'holdout' is the same draw as the calibration set and parameter selection would be evaluated on the data it was chosen from
guard: the calibration and holdout datasets are independent draws: different generator seeds and different feature values for the same project index
